description: The SQL scenarios every language executes against MariaDB.

scenarios.name: statement
scenarios.description: Runs a direct query and verifies that it returns one true value.

scenarios.name: prepared_statement
scenarios.description: Binds an integer to a prepared query that must return no rows.
scenarios.sql: SELECT name FROM conformance.items WHERE id = ${id}

scenarios.name: batch
scenarios.description: Executes two inserts as one batch and verifies that both statements succeed.

scenarios.name: stored_procedure
scenarios.description: Calls the no-op stored procedure and verifies that it returns no result sets.
